purpose: Immutable self-scoped idempotency receipt for B04-A Temporal Constraint create, revise and retire mutations.

columns.name: self_person_ref
columns.meaning: Authenticated self Person scoping the operation identifier.
columns.value_contract: Existing self Person NativeRef; receipt identity remains technical and distinct from Temporal Constraint identity.

columns.name: operation_id
columns.meaning: Caller-supplied idempotency identity for one constraint mutation attempt stream.
columns.value_contract: Trimmed, non-empty and at most 200 characters.

columns.name: intent_fingerprint
columns.meaning: Canonical SHA-256 fingerprint of the materially relevant mutation intent.

columns.name: mutation_kind
columns.meaning: Lifecycle operation represented by this immutable receipt.

columns.name: constraint_ref
columns.meaning: Stable Temporal Constraint identity targeted or created by this operation.
columns.value_contract: Existing or atomically created Temporal Constraint identity, depending on mutation_kind.

columns.name: subject_native_ref
columns.meaning: Activity/Event subject frozen into the accepted mutation intent.
columns.value_contract: Must match the subject of constraint_ref.

columns.name: expected_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: Expected current rule state used as CAS precondition for revise/retire.
columns.value_contract: Null for create; required and owned by the same constraint for revise/retire.

columns.name: resulting_material_state_ref
columns.meaning: New immutable rule MaterialState accepted by create/revise, null for retire.
columns.value_contract: Required for create/revise and globally unique among accepted mutation receipts; null for retire.

columns.name: created_at
columns.meaning: Authoritative instant at which this mutation receipt was accepted.
columns.value_contract: Recorded in the same database transaction as the canonical mutation effect.

primary_key.name: pk_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation
primary_key.reason: Self Person plus operation id is the database arbiter for B04-A mutation idempotency.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_self_person_person
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Scope operation identity to an existing self Person without making the receipt a Domain identity.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_constraint_subject
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: Freeze the exact stable constraint and subject pair accepted by the mutation.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_expected_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: When present, the CAS expectation must be a rule state of the same stable constraint.

foreign_keys.name: fk_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_resulting_state
foreign_keys.semantic_reason: When present, the accepted result state belongs to the same stable constraint.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_operation_id
check_constraints.reason: Require one bounded normalized operation identity.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_fingerprint
check_constraints.reason: Require the canonical SHA-256 hexadecimal fingerprint representation used for replay comparison.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_kind
check_constraints.reason: Bound the receipt to the three B04-A lifecycle mutations.

check_constraints.name: ck_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_state_shape
check_constraints.expression_contract: (mutation_kind='create' AND expected_material_state_ref IS NULL AND resulting_material_state_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (mutation_kind='revise' AND expected_material_state_ref IS NOT NULL AND resulting_material_state_ref IS NOT NULL) OR (mutation_kind='retire' AND expected_material_state_ref IS NOT NULL AND resulting_material_state_ref IS NULL)
check_constraints.reason: Encode the exact CAS/result shape of create, revise and retire receipts.

indexes.name: ix_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_constraint_ref
indexes.reason: Mutation audit/replay lookup by stable constraint identity.

indexes.name: ux_temporal_constraint_mutation_operation_resulting_state
indexes.reason: One accepted mutation receipt owns each newly created rule MaterialState result.

state_history.material_state_behavior: The receipt records expected/resulting MaterialState identities but is not itself canonical rule state.
state_history.current_binding: CAS expectation protects accepted currentness; replay returns the previously accepted result and never selects current state by newest-row ordering.
state_history.chronology: created_at is receipt chronology only; operation_id and UUID identity are not temporal ordering substitutes.
state_history.immutability_policy: Receipts are immutable. Same self Person plus operation_id may replay only materially identical accepted intent; changed intent is a conflict.

lifecycle.retention: Retained while required for safe idempotent mutation replay and conflict detection.
lifecycle.delete_behavior: No runtime DELETE; receipt retention is independent from Temporal Constraint retirement.

obligations: same self Person and operation_id plus materially identical intent replays the accepted result
same idempotency key with changed intent is rejected
revise and retire require exact expected current MaterialStateRef
receipt identity remains distinct from Temporal Constraint and MaterialState identity
